title: Hive Sync — Project Configuration
description: Single-document, declarative configuration for an entire Hive Sync install. Produced by /wp-admin AJAX hsync_ajax_project_export and consumed by hsync_ajax_project_apply. Round-trippable: export -> edit -> apply yields the same result as the original. Secrets are redacted on export (••••XXXX) and preserved by the applier when posted back as the same placeholder.

sources.description: Saved source configs (URL + credentials + per-feed knobs). Each entry corresponds to a row in wp_hsync_source_configs.

mappings.description: External-to-Woo field maps. Each entry is a row in wp_hsync_mappings.

pipelines.description: Composable lifecycle pipelines (pre_check + import_rule + check). Rows in wp_hsync_pipelines.

rules.description: Scoped operations on existing products. Rows in wp_hsync_rules.

jobs.description: Scheduled or ad-hoc Runnable references. Rows in wp_hsync_jobs.

slug.description: Stable identifier. Referenced by jobs.runnable_ref as '<kind>/<slug>'.

config.description:
Free-form bag of fields validated by the Source's configSchema(). Common keys per kind:
  - json: url, token, cookie, flavor (generic|goldensneakers), import_status (publish|draft), markup_percent, markup_rules
  - csv:  url, file, delimiter, has_header, flavor (generic|stockfirmati), category_filter, sf_markup_mode, sf_markup_value, import_status, markup_percent, markup_rules
Secrets (token/cookie/api_key/password) are redacted on export to '••••XXXX' and preserved server-side when posted back unchanged.

Target-Woo-field -> source-spec map. Source-spec is one of: - plain top-level key: 'sku', 'product_name' - dot-path traversal: 'sizes.size_eu', 'meta.brand' - templated string: '{brand_name} {name}', '

{description}

' Canonical Woo target slots: - Required: sku, name, regular_price - Standard: description, image_url, categories, brand, stock_quantity, sale_price, stock_status, manage_stock, status, gallery_urls, tags, meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords, short_description - Attributes: pa_brand, pa_model, pa_gender, pa_color, pa_material, pa_taglia (variation). Any pa_ is auto-promoted into Woo product attributes by AttributeMerger; the global taxonomy is auto-created by ResolveTaxonomy when missing. - Custom: any other key the operator wants to pass through (used by SEO/meta plugins or downstream Operations).

kind.description:
When the step runs:
  - pre_check  : on FeedItem before materialize (severity=block can skip)
  - import_rule: mutates the draft before materialize (only ImportRule ops)
  - operation  : runs on a productId (post-create or for Rule editor)
  - check      : on a productId after materialize (severity=warn|block)

ref_id.description:
ID of the registered Operation/Check class. Common values:
  - import.has_required_fields, import.has_media_url
  - media.download, media.has_images
  - taxonomy.auto_categorize, taxonomy.resolve, taxonomy.has_category
  - pricing.markup_percent, pricing.adjust_price
  - status.set, stock.set_stock_status, stock.set_stock_quantity

params.description: Per-step parameters consumed by the Op/Check::paramsSchema(). Free-form.

selection.description: How to pick target products: { mode: 'ids'|'filter'|'all', ... }

operations.description: List of { ref_id, params } where ref_id is a registered Operation (NOT an ImportRule). Periodic pricing percent is forbidden by design — use markup_rules on the source-config instead.

slug.description: Stable identity. Stored as config._seed_id since wp_hsync_jobs has no slug column. The exporter derives one from runnable_type+ref+cron when missing.

runnable_ref.description: For source.import: '<kind>/<source-slug>' e.g. 'json/gs-prod', 'csv/sf-prod'. For pipeline/rule: the slug.

cron.description: 5-field cron expression (m h dom mon dow). Empty/missing = ad-hoc only.

options.description:
Per-job knobs. Common keys:
  - mapping_slug:  pick a saved Mapping (resolved at dispatch)
  - pipeline_slug: pick a saved Pipeline
  - buckets: subset of ['new','update','updateStock'] — KEY perf control
  - limit: cap the run (test-fetch on big feeds)
  - category_filter: restrict the source fetch to a category subset
